title_sq: Tek Kopshti Botanik, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Pamje Te Lire Nga Tirana!
description_sq: Tek Kopshti Botanik, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, me Pamje te Lire nga Tirana! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3-te dhe eshte i vetmi apartament ne kat te nje pallati me 4 kate dhe ka siperfaqe totale 149.3 m2 dhe neto 132.75m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes, kendi i gatimit i vecuar, 2 dhomat e gjumit, 2 tualete njeri me dritare dhe dy ballkone njeri me pamje te lire nga Tirana. Eshte i investuar dhe i mobiluar ne menyre komode dhe bashkekohore. Disponon Post Parkim i përshtatshëm për 2 makina me cmim ekstra. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara per banim duke qene se ndodhet prane dy liqeneve. Ajri i paster dhe qetesia ne zone e ben nga me te kerkuarat per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At the Botanical Garden, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with a view of Tirana!
description_en: At the Botanical Garden, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with a view from Tirana! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor and is the only apartment on the floor of a building with 4 floors and has a total area of ​​149.3 m2 and a net area of ​​132.75 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room, a separate kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with windows and two balconies with a clear view of Tirana. It is invested and furnished in a comfortable and contemporary way. There is Post Parking suitable for 2 cars at an extra cost. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most preferred areas for living, since it is located near two lakes. The clean air and tranquility in the area make it one of the most sought after for a comfortable and peaceful life. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
